state.question: Count the cells in this fluorescence microscopy image of Hoechst-stained nuclei. Return your estimated total cell count as a number.

answer.explanation: Estimated approximately 300 cells, using the visible nuclei and watershed counts of 295 and 297 as guides.
limitations: Touching nuclei and partial nuclei at image borders introduce counting uncertainty; segmented regions are not individually verified cells.
